everyEighthDayWhatever: Every eighth day, whatever day of the week it falls on.
thisIsAnExample: This is an example of how one market might work. Some markets in Delta State run on an eight-day cycle, so market day lands on a different weekday each time. Others keep a fixed day of the week, like every Saturday. Marketdey follows each market's own schedule and alerts you at 6 pm the evening before and 6 am the morning of.
